name: @ac-brandsframework/eds-assets-dekker
description: DS-sourced EDS assets for the Dekker (dekker-lib) brand -- compiled DOM-build render JS and cascade-safe CSS for Dekker's single-component blocks (one per @edsBlock tag, listed in the published README.md), option lists (options/) for style props, runtime glue (js/vendor/), and Dekker's own globals+grid CSS (css/foundational/dekker-lib.css, css/brands.json). Sibling package to @ac-brandsframework/eds-assets and @ac-brandsframework/eds-assets-acg. See README.md in the published package for the dist layout.
